usual_baseline: Rationale is usually recorded (85–100%). Plans to reduce or stop are not: timescale for stopping 29% [3445], reduce/stop plan 10–17% [3685], no clear indication for 50.6% of antipsychotics [3584]. Monitoring and consent are weak: consent and monitoring under 10% [3192], metabolic monitoring 0% [3268]. One CAMHS service scored 98% [3359].
fix_that_works: Repeated cycles in one ID team: metabolic monitoring 0% to 95%, risk assessment 68% to 100%, target behaviour described 74% to 100% [3268].
fix_that_fails: Side-effect discussion at initiation fell from 73% to 38% after criteria changed [3416]. Consent stayed low (19% to 46%), and single drug therapy 19% to 34% [3268]. Mental health evaluation fell from 87% to 60% [3268].
consultant_advice: Thirteen audits, only two re-audited. Documenting a rationale is solved. Audit whether a reduce-or-stop plan with a timescale exists and is acted on, and count actual dose reductions, not just reviews.
